authority_basis: F13 (Arif) order 2026-11-17: 'a and b' — run target-release retest + profile F6
scope: P1-5f (A-FORGE->arifFLOW receipt emission) + P1-6 (telemetry wiring). P1-7 deprecation flags NOT touched.

harness.note: /root/A-FORGE/scripts and /root/A-FORGE/reports are chattr +i (immutable); harness placed in retest/

census.note: prod fallback stayed at 0 lines throughout: the retest never pushed prod into the drop path

S1_retry.method: 3 emissions against unreachable arifFLOW (127.0.0.1:7079), isolated fallback file, then live emission + sweeper drain
checks: 3 emissions returned ok=false (honest failure, not false success)
replayed ledger appended; markers durably present in /var/lib/arifflow/receipts.jsonl (3 hits)
S1_retry.evidence_class: MEASURED (loopback transport failure, prod daemon untouched)

S2_duplicate.method: same receipt_id POSTed twice, then same content with fresh UUID

residual_hazard.meaning: same content with a new receipt_id is a NEW receipt by design (documented by arifFLOW). Because the sweeper regenerates receipt_id at replay time, a request that LANDED but whose response was lost can be replayed as a second receipt and double-count in FQ.
residual_hazard.severity: LOW-MEDIUM — requires response loss after successful store; not observed in this run

S3_restart.method: fresh-process emission + live `systemctl restart a-forge-mcp.service` + real MCP tool call after restart
checks: live tools/call forge_health_check served by restarted process
receipt attributable to actor retest.p1-5-6 landed in arifFLOW after restart
kimi MCP stdio bridge reconnected without manual intervention
local audit sink (/root/.agent-workbench/mcp-audit.jsonl) mtime advanced post-restart

S4_receipt_writer_failure.method: loopback stub returning HTTP 500 on /ingest for the writer; both emission paths exercised
checks: both failures persisted to fallback, delta=2, nothing dropped
S4_receipt_writer_failure.evidence_class: SIMULATED_WRITER_FAILURE — HTTP 500 stub; production writer was NOT killed. A true daemon-side write error is still unproven.

findings.statement: Two modules read different env var names: receipts/arifflowClient.js reads ARIFLOW_URL (single F); bridges/arifFlowBridge.js reads ARIFFLOW_URL (double F). Neither is set in the systemd units, so production silently uses the hardcoded default http://127.0.0.1:7073 for both.
findings.consequence: The documented kill switch/seam (ARIFFLOW_URL=off, or pointing at another plane) disables or redirects only ONE of the two emitters. Incident isolation is half-blind.
findings.fix: One spelling in both files (canonical: ARIFFLOW_URL, matching the bridge comment + AGENTS.md), or read one shared config value.

findings.statement: forge_health_check post-restart reports telemetry.totalEvents=0 with since=2026-11-16T19:37:31Z, while a tool call was served seconds earlier.
findings.consequence: Either counters are not wired to the tool-call path or they measure a different stream. Cannot be used as P1-6 evidence until disambiguated.

findings.statement: /root/A-FORGE/scripts and /root/A-FORGE/reports carry chattr +i. New harnesses cannot be added there without unlocking the seal.
findings.consequence: Good for tamper-evidence; means retest tooling must live in a third location (retest/).

gate_recommendation.basis: 4/4 named scenarios pass on target release 1d35639; no silent drop observed on any failure path; prod fallback stayed empty.
conditions_before_flipping_P1-7: Resolve F-ENV-SPELLING so the seam is testable and the kill switch is total, not partial
Accept S4 as SIMULATED unless a real daemon-writer error is induced on a maintenance window
Decide whether the fresh-UUID replay double-count (S2 residual) is acceptable or needs idempotency on content hash
not_covered_by_this_run: process death mid-write (SIGKILL between ingest and store) — only clean restart tested
concurrent sweeps across two processes replaying the same backlog
